quote: I use AI the way a careful editor uses a fast typist. The thinking is mine. The execution is shared.
witLine: // not a vibe coder. not even close.

points.title: Specify before prompting
points.description: I know the behavior, the edge cases, and the constraints before I write a prompt. Garbage in, garbage out is a thinking problem, not a model problem.

points.title: Every output reviewed like a PR
points.description: I read it, question it, test it. If I cannot explain a line, it does not ship.

points.title: Ownership stays with me
points.description: When something breaks in production, the model is not accountable. I am. That shapes every decision about what to generate and what to write myself.

points.title: AI speeds up execution, not thinking
points.description: Rethinking architecture mid-build is expensive no matter what tool you use. The thinking happens first, always.
